facts.fact: DHIS2 says MoBSE's Education Data Centre, on DHIS2-Ed, now gives live dashboards that update as new information flows in, with historical census data migrated into it, replacing paper census forms and yearbooks.
DHIS2 says MoBSE's digital student registry, piloted in 2020 in 200 schools, gives each learner a unique ID and has scaled nationwide, with nearly 80% of Gambian learners included.

systems.owner: Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education
